vus.texte: ✅ Prêt — 107 mots préparés, 1 min 18 s couvertes
the surface of a black hole marks the space,
within which matter and light remain trapped without space.
This is the horizon of events.
The material swirls before disappearing forever.
She draws an outline that reveals the invisible.
The death of my first stars,
supermassive black holes, fed for billions
the surface of a black hole marks the space,
inside which matter and light remain trapped without hope
This is the horizon of events.
The material swirls before it ever disappears.
She draws an outline that reveals the invisible.
